svg.aria-label: ADR-010: four questions from two outside readings; the system frozen at a named commit; the parts A to E: the sealed families, the references and the cost, the scale cost probe with the cascade, the free text value deferred, the construction's ceiling delivered; the order from the declaration to the tag; what the ADR does not claim
svg.title: ADR-010 — The independent test and the industrial door: four questions, one frozen system, the parts A to E, one order
svg.text: The independent test and the industrial door: four questions, one frozen system, read once
quantum-cortex, original figure for ADR-010. Declared before any number, with a committee; the record's position unchanged: the model decides, the organ answers, the verdict is the system's.
Four questions, from two outside readings of the record

g.text: generalisation
formulations no model and no selection has seen
the veto's guarantee
outside the synthetic protocol, and at scale
the simpler references
what a buyer's first stack does on the same questions
the cost
by stage, by configuration, and with the journal's size

svg.text: The frozen system: the mechanism built and measured first, then the system frozen at a named commit before any family is planted
every module of the organ, the model's code, the configurations and the tests hashed at the freeze; from that commit to the tag the frozen files do not change and every build adds new modules
and tests only; the record test of each row compares the hashes; no checkpoint encodes a sealed text before the founder's runs; a key is never committed; the founder's files travel in his commits
Part A: the sealed families, read once

g.text: three families read on the frozen system before the tag: an in
template control (the protocol's templates, new names); unseen
formulations (new templates and vocabularies, built to five rules
pinned by tests); the value cell (the templates with the new values);
a fourth, public development family is never read as a result
the seal: generated from the constants and committed by content
hash before any encoder runs on them; the texts regenerate from
public code, the seal fixes their content and dates it, it hides nothing
the label: "a synthetic set locked before execution, not a blind
validation: the templates and the generating rules are public"
the readings written before any number, letter by letter; the
construction table written first, so that no letter counts a
construction fact as a result; a refusal at the gate never stops a run

svg.text: Part B: the simple references, and the cost

g.text: one planting, three indexes over the same entries, one pass per index:
the organ's own index; an exhaustive cosine over the same cues,
no buckets (a component ablation); a lexical search (the stack a
buyer tries first); every window with the organ's marks
the rules on every index: the model alone; the veto; the veto with
the organ's value; an exact key verifier, "a key rule, exact on these
families by construction"; the mark oracle with no model
the cost by stage, timed in one process on one thread, with the
operation counts and the sizes; labelled "not a scale result"
three outcomes per paired test, never written as "equal": the organ's
stack better, the reference better, not separated at this size; if a buyer
stack holds the conditions wherever the organ's does and no test favours
the organ's, the record says the read side brings no measured advantage

svg.text: Part C: the scale cost probe with the cascade

g.text: synthetic journals larger than the protocol's, the
facts in a seeded order, cues from each checkpoint's
encoder, the largest draw under one; two gates;
near duplicates of two kinds at a declared rate
the never planted control against the threshold: the
count above it at each size, with its interval, is the
number at which the veto's guarantee is measured to
end, never a claim that it holds beyond those sizes
the cascade, its construction law stated before the
run: the withdrawal check after every phase, a
returned withdrawn address is a fault, attributed first
the cost curves reported with their construction,
no threshold to pass; the probe's own time reported

svg.text: Part E: the construction's ceiling under byte keys, delivered
no model, no journal key: the simplest reference to the model's selection, per read its top line
against the decoder's own citation, with the oracle beside; a tie at the top is not decisive
Part D: the free text value, deferred to the next edition
outside the templates the organ reads nothing and the system abstains; three shapes are named
for a dated amendment, to be measured on an independent family written by an outside author
The order, from the declaration to the tag

g.text: declared
with a committee, before any number
built
new modules only, tests first
run by the founder
every file retained before any is read
read cold
from the files, committed functions
graved
a record test, a dated section
the tag
after a rerun on a clean tree

svg.text: not claimed: that the families are natural text; that the references are the best of their kind; that a cost measured on one processor is the cost; no prediction

g.text: the questions and the founder's runs
what is sealed, read and graved
what is declared and compared
the frozen system and the part deferred
